name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent above $110 as Hormuz stays largely closed and Doha talks continue
state: Brent last settled near $111.8, above the $110 Alert line and up 9% over the month. At least four tankers were hit near Hormuz on 30–31 Oct. Iranian negotiators met Qatari mediators in Doha for a third day on 1 Nov on a plan to reopen the strait within two days if the US cooperates; Trump said he was in no hurry for a deal.
for_you: Expect continued high petrol, diesel and heating-oil prices, with knock-on effects on transport costs and inflation.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran war live: US response awaited on new proposal to reopen Hormuz

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
